children: Shares of Ardent Health fell after the company priced its secondary public offering of 8 million shares at $14.50 apiece.
Shares were down 19% at $14.33 Wednesday. The stock is up 61% year to date.
The health and nursing company's secondary offering consists of about 7.1 million shares by an affiliate of Equity Group Investments and about 863,000 shares by an affiliate of Ventas.
In connection with the offering, expected to close Thursday, underwriters have a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional 1.2 million shares of the stock.
After the offering's completion, Ardent Health will also repurchase from the underwriters 1.5 million shares of its stock that are subject to the offering.
